verdicts.evidence: lines 601-611 row actions (paid, reminder, undo, delete, retry, dismiss) all dispatch; 613-621 dialog buttons; 633-654 filters, clear, show more, refresh, retry all have listeners that change state and re-render.

lines 517-529: rows come only from api.listInvoices; 422 filter counts and 449-454 summary are computed from loaded data and blank until loaded; 431 'Updated' time is the real load time. No hardcoded figures or placeholder text.
lines 591-599: the delete confirmation names the invoice number in its title and shows customer, amount and due date in the body, so the choice does not rely on memory of the row.
Only one search input and a status filter (lines 150-162); no multi-step task, no long free text. (Search and status are kept in the URL anyway, lines 324-330.)
lines 211-212 and 597-598: 'Keep draft' is first in the dialog and receives focus after showModal, so Enter keeps the draft. Line 157: the preselected filter is 'All'.
lines 348-349, 606: Mark paid and Send reminder are buttons in the table row; one press starts the action on the same screen with no dialog or other page. Only permanent delete takes an extra step.

lines 141-202: heading, search, status filter, result summary, table, show more. No stat cards, charts or feeds. Refresh and 'Updated' time (143-146) are the only items not literally named; judged as load-state support for a shared all-day list.

line 173: 'Try again' is the only primary button in the load-error panel; 211-212: dialog has primary 'Keep draft' and outlined 'Delete draft'; 338-339 row buttons are plain; toolbar buttons (145, 168, 193-195, 201) are plain.

line 350: row Delete uses outlined .danger style (42-43) and appears only on drafts, which have no other row action; 211-212, 598: in the dialog Delete draft is outlined, second, and focus goes to Keep draft so Enter does not delete.

lines 346-351: actions that do not apply to a status are not rendered. The only disabled control is Refresh with aria-disabled while its own request runs, labelled 'Refreshing...' (428-430, 490-491), which is the stated exception.
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script.

All visible strings (lines 142-212, 333-337, 432, 441, 488-503, 594-595) concern invoices and their actions. No mention of implementation, mock data or the request. The simulated server error text is never displayed (catch at 530, 583 ignores e).

The only notice-like texts are 'Could not refresh. Showing invoices from HH:MM.' beside the Refresh button (line 432) and 'Permanently delete draft ...?' inside the delete decision (594). No tips, banners or disclaimers.
The only guidance is the field label 'Search by customer or invoice number' (line 151), one short line at its control. No text narrates the page or its controls.
The h1 (line 142) has no subtitle, the search field has no helper text, and no section has an introduction.
Heading is 'Invoices' (line 142); messages are factual ('Updated 14:02', 'No invoices yet.', 'Marking as paid in 5s'). No greeting, slogan, superlative or exclamation mark in any string.

Action labels: Refresh, Try again, Clear search/filter (460), Show all statuses, Show N more (478), Mark paid, Send reminder, Delete, Undo, Dismiss (348-361), Keep draft, Delete draft (211-212). Status filter toggles (157-161) are option names under a 'Status' label, judged as options.

line 287 statusName shows 'Draft', 'Sent', 'Paid', 'Overdue'; 383 shows the invoice number (NW-...) not the inv_ id; dates and money are formatted for en-GB (270-279). Column heads are Invoice, Customer, Due, Amount, Status.

lines 334-336, 441, 432: 'Could not load invoices. The server did not respond.' with Try again; 'Could not mark as paid...', 'Reminder not sent...', 'Could not delete...' each with Try again (360-361). The raw ECONNRESET message is never shown.
Error strings (lines 249, 334-336, 432, 441) use 'Could not ...' and 'not sent'; none contains 'failed', 'invalid', 'oops', an exclamation mark or capitals, and none blames the user.

lines 482-506: zero records shows 'No invoices yet.' with a Refresh button; an unmatched search or status shows a specific line with Clear search or Show all statuses. The table is hidden (463), so no bare headers.

lines 487-505: no records gives 'No invoices yet.' + Refresh; unmatched search gives 'No invoices match "q".' + Clear search; unmatched status gives 'No overdue invoices.' + Show all statuses; 439-441: load failure has its own panel with Try again.

lines 530-535, 439-441: failed first load shows a message and Try again in place of the table; failed refresh keeps the rows and says so (432); 583-587, 360-361: a failed row action shows its message in the row with Try again; search text is untouched.

lines 447, 465-468: first load shows 'Loading invoices...' and skeleton rows at once; 429 Refresh reads 'Refreshing...'; 357-358 row actions show a spinner with 'Marking as paid...' etc. No call can exceed 1.5 s, so no progress or cancel is needed.

lines 415, 422, 482: before the first response state.loaded is false, so filter counts are blank, the summary reads 'Loading invoices...', skeleton rows show, and the empty panel (isEmpty needs loaded) stays hidden.

line 73 customer wraps (overflow-wrap anywhere), 71 amounts nowrap and tabular; 247, 470-479 rows paged 50 at a time; 274-287, 383-384 missing values read 'No date', 'No amount', 'No number', 'No customer', 'Unknown'; 108-109 dialog text wraps.
The screen holds no edits saved by an explicit action; each action is sent on its own. (A pending or in-flight action still triggers a beforeunload prompt, lines 656-658.)
The only field is a free-text search (line 152) with no format, length or value constraint.
No form with required and optional fields; only a single optional search box (lines 150-153).
No input validation exists; the search field filters as typed and never reports an error (line 632).
No form that can reject input.
No form that can be rejected by client or server.
No form that can reject input.
No form element and no submit button on the screen.
No form submits to the server. (Row actions are guarded anyway: startHold returns if an operation exists for the row, line 541, and the buttons are replaced by status text, 353-358.)

line 549: pressing Mark paid or Send reminder re-renders the row at once with countdown text and Undo; 567 sending shows spinner text; 519-520 load renders loading state before awaiting; 597 Delete opens the dialog; 624-638 filters render synchronously.

lines 576-581: on success the row updates in place and is kept in view (status Paid, 'Reminder sent today, HH:MM' at 381, or a 'Draft ... deleted' row at 368-370); 583-586 a failure is stated in the row.
No success toast, banner or dialog. Outcomes appear as the changed row itself; the say() messages (line 582) go only to a visually hidden live region for screen readers.

lines 359-362: a row error stays with Try again and Dismiss until the user acts; 439-441 load error stays until retry; 432 refresh error stays until the next refresh. No toasts or timers remove errors. The 5 s Undo countdown is the pending action itself, not a message.

lines 539-561, 606-607: Mark paid and Send reminder run with no confirmation dialog; a 5 second in-row countdown with an Undo button cancels before the request is sent, since the server has no way to reverse either.

lines 591-599, 211-212: delete asks 'Permanently delete draft NW-...?' with customer, amount and due date, buttons 'Keep draft' and 'Delete draft', focus on Keep draft. Reminder and mark paid get a cancel window instead of a dialog (539-561).
The only confirmation dialog (lines 207-214, opened only at 608) guards permanent deletion of a draft. Frequent actions, filters, refresh and dismiss have none.
lines 563-582: the row's status changes only after the server call resolves; while waiting it shows pending text. No optimistic update.
lines 207-214, 591-599: the one modal holds a single keep-or-delete decision and opens only when the user presses a row's Delete button.

line 597 uses a native dialog with showModal(), giving focus trap, Escape to close and focus return to the Delete button; 598 focus starts on Keep draft; 211 visible cancel control; 618-619 after deletion focus is placed on the row.
lines 141-188: heading, then search and status filter, a one-line summary, then the invoice table. Nothing decorative precedes or outweighs the table.
lines 141-147: the page opens with the h1 'Invoices' and goes straight to the search, filter and table. No hero, greeting or intro panel.

lines 157-161, 422: the only summary numbers are per-status counts on the filter buttons (for example how many are overdue, which is a named task) and the result count in the summary line (449-454). No stat cards or charts.

lines 445-460: when filtered the summary reads 'N of M invoices: overdue, matching "q"' with one 'Clear search and filter' button beside it (640); the pressed filter is also marked (421); empty filtered results name the filter and offer clearing (492-505).

All controls are native button, input and dialog elements (lines 145-212, 338-339). Focus is restored after row and full re-renders (397-404, 409-413, 509-513), and after show more (643-650). No click-only custom widgets.

line 376 the overdue badge carries the word 'Overdue' plus days; 360 errors are text; 432-433 the refresh failure is worded as well as red; 57 the selected filter is filled and bold with aria-pressed, and the summary line names the filter in text.

Live regions exist in the initial markup: #fresh, #summary, #moreText, #emptyText role=status (144, 167, 191, 200), #loadErrorText role=alert (172), and sr-only #live (204) filled by say() for action progress, results and failures (300-305, 550, 582, 587).
No accordions, disclosure buttons, menus, comboboxes or tabs. The status filter is a group of toggle buttons with aria-pressed (lines 156-162, 421).

lines 112-136: at 760px and below rows become stacked grid cards with a 'Due' label, controls are 44px high, search is full width, filters and row actions wrap; 106 the dialog width is min(440px, 100vw - 32px) and its buttons wrap (110).
